title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
summary_full: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a run-off on Oct. 25.
